rationale: No E2E spec covers span/service-name truncation + tooltips in the trace detail view. traceGenAiParts.spec.js shares the same ingestion + navigate + open-trace setup pattern (and is the closest sibling) but only asserts GenAI v5 `parts` rendering; traceDetails.spec.js covers panel features (timeline, copy ID, view logs, search, share link), not the truncation/title behavior. The change is a distinct feature area (presentational truncation of span/service names), so a brand-new spec is warranted. It must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the Traces run_files array (needs_registration: true).
